Add a schedule (give one of --every, --daily, --weekly)

Usage: cua agent schedule add [OPTIONS] --title <TITLE> --prompt <PROMPT> <AGENT>

Arguments:
  <AGENT>
          

Options:
      --title <TITLE>
          

      --embedded
          Use an embedded runtime even when a daemon runs

      --prompt <PROMPT>
          

      --daemon <DAEMON>
          Daemon address (socket path or loopback URL)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON=]

      --every <MINUTES>
          Every N minutes

      --daemon-token <DAEMON_TOKEN>
          Daemon token (loopback URLs)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON_TOKEN]

      --daily <HH:MM>
          Every day at HH:MM

      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          Sandbox state directory (embedded; default ~/.cua/sandboxes)

      --weekly <DAY HH:MM>
          Every week, `mon 09:00`

      --json
          Print JSON

  -h, --help
          Print help

Examples:
  cua agent schedule add ada --title "Inbox sweep" --prompt "Triage new issues" --every 60
  cua agent schedule add ada --title "Morning" --prompt "Plan the day" --daily 08:00
